notes.title: Friends, Salangan Games and the dragon Higan wishes you Happy Chinese New Year!
notes.content: Friends! Chinese New Year is approaching. It's not exactly our national holiday, but, as they say, there's no reason not to have a drink. That's exactly what this new short story from the Zelirian Stories series is about. To read the latest story, launch [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1490190/Happy_New_Year_Zeliria/]DLC "Happy New Year, Zeliria! - Dragon![/url]"

notes.title: A new New Year's story is already available!
notes.content: Dear friends! We are glad to present you another New Year's story about the heroes of Zeliria Sanctuary - "Salad"! This little funny story tells about the events of another new year on Zeliria! And also about what can happen if you cook an unfamiliar dish.

notes.title: Another short story from the Zeliria Chronicles is available. Happy New Year!
notes.content:
We introduce you another New Year's story about the heroes of Zeliria Sanctuary - "Misunderstanding"! 
This story tells how Missy and Jay's lives turned out! A touching little funny story will let you get to know these characters a little better, and we also hope that it will bring you real New Year's mood.

notes.title: New Year and new festive events on Zeliria!
notes.content: Friends! We present you another New Year's story about the heroes of Zeliria Sanctuary! The DLC for our first story is called "Let's take another walk" and tells how the life of Maxx and Velga turned out... on Earth! This a bit philosophical, a bit joyful and a bit sad story will give you a look at your favorite characters from a new side. Yes, yes, and Humkey too :) Have a nice game!

notes.title: Reality's Reversу Side is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content: Reality's reverse side is a quite unusual novel about an ordinary detective who has no cases for a long time. But one day everything changes and Stefan (that's the name of the main character) gets a new case, and a new life together with it, full of interesting, and sometimes very dangerous adventures. Do vampires exist? What is Zhonki hiding? Should you marry Cutie Hugh? Will Stefan be able to return to his former place of work? Or will he decide to stay? Or maybe he... will die? Well, you can find the answers to all these questions right now!
